**Direction: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

A violent wind that has a circular movement
solution: The correct answer is **"Hurricane."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Hurricane"** is a violent wind that has a circular movement. (बहुत तेज़ हवाओं वाली उग्र आँधी, आँधी-तूफ़ान) • **Example**: ***Hurricane**__ force winds are expected tonight.* • The word **'hurricane'** is derived from the Spanish word** 'huracundefinedn'.** • The correct answer is option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Drought**: A prolonged period of abnormally low rainfall, leading to a shortage of water. (लंबे समय तक असामान्य रूप से कम वर्षा के कारण पानी की कमी हो जाना) • **Deluge**: A severe flood. (एकाएक मूसलाधार वर्षा; बाढ़ • **Tsunami**: A long high sea wave caused by an earthquake, submarine landslide, or other disturbance. (भूकंप, पनडुब्बी भूस्खलन या अन्य गड़बड़ी के कारण होने वाली लंबी ऊंची समुद्री लहर) 41:Tc1a, The correct answer is **"Drained."**
